surfaces.title: HTTP request semantics
surfaces.description: Methods, destinations, fetch metadata, redirects, cookies, cache and resource graph.

surfaces.title: HTTP header shape
surfaces.description: Header values, presence, ordering and cross-request coherence.

surfaces.title: HTTP/2 frame fingerprint
surfaces.description: Strict preface/frame parsing, SETTINGS, pseudo-header order, connection flow-control and bounded frame sequence.

surfaces.title: HTTP/3 request fingerprint
surfaces.description: Strict QUIC varints, control/request frame sequence, SETTINGS and bounded QPACK encoder/decoder stream shapes from decrypted streams.

surfaces.title: TLS ClientHello fingerprint
surfaces.description: Versions, ciphers, extensions, groups, signature algorithms, GREASE, SNI and ALPN.

surfaces.title: TLS session lifecycle
surfaces.description: ClientHello PSK/early-data offers correlated with negotiated version/ALPN, resumption, tickets, key updates, handshake timing and request reuse.

surfaces.title: QUIC transport fingerprint
surfaces.description: Normalized transport parameters, version, ALPN, resumption, 0-RTT, retry and migration lifecycle.

surfaces.title: TCP/IP stack fingerprint
surfaces.description: Privacy-safe normalized SYN/IP evidence: version, initial/observed TTL and hops, MSS, window/scale, ordered options, SACK/timestamps/ECN, retransmissions and bounded pacing.

surfaces.title: DNS and WebRTC network coherence
surfaces.description: Privacy-safe DNS transport/query aggregates plus SDP shape, ICE state/timing, candidate type/protocol/address class and mDNS behavior without retaining IPs or query labels.

surfaces.title: IP and ASN evidence
surfaces.description: Longest-prefix offline CIDR policy plus optional local MaxMind ASN enrichment with dataset hash, mtime and provider provenance.

surfaces.title: Browser identity and UA-CH
surfaces.description: UA, UA-CH, platform, vendor, locale and timezone coherence.

surfaces.title: Hardware capability shape
surfaces.description: Concurrency, memory, touch, battery and device capability consistency.

surfaces.title: Screen and viewport topology
surfaces.description: Screen, available area, viewport, outer dimensions, DPR, depth and orientation.

surfaces.title: CSS media and preference surfaces
surfaces.description: Color gamut, HDR, contrast, motion, transparency, pointer and hover media queries.

surfaces.title: Permissions and capability state
surfaces.description: Permissions API, notification, clipboard, media and sensor capability coherence.

surfaces.title: Storage and partitioning
surfaces.description: First-party cookies/storage/quota/cache/worker/OPFS shape correlated with a second-origin iframe receipt and Storage Access API state.

surfaces.title: Canvas rendering
surfaces.description: 2D text, shapes, compositing, readback and stability digests.

surfaces.title: WebGL capabilities and rendering
surfaces.description: Vendor, renderer, extensions, limits, precision and render output.

surfaces.title: WebGPU capabilities and rendering
surfaces.description: Adapter identity, features, limits, preferred format, deterministic WGSL compute execution and mapped buffer readback.

surfaces.title: Fonts and text rasterization
surfaces.description: Font presence and fallback, cross-script TextMetrics, sampled canvas raster output, emoji and variable-font support.

surfaces.title: DOM and ClientRect micro-geometry
surfaces.description: Element rects, glyph bounds, SVG geometry, scrollbars, zoom and subpixel behavior.

surfaces.title: CSS and native control defaults
surfaces.description: UA stylesheet, native controls, computed style and pseudo-element shape.

surfaces.title: Audio processing fingerprint
surfaces.description: Offline audio rendering, base latency and audio API shape.

surfaces.title: Media codec capability fingerprint
surfaces.description: canPlayType, MediaCapabilities, WebCodecs, container and codec combinations.

surfaces.title: Media device shape
surfaces.description: Bounded device inventory before/after, kind counts, label/group exposure, supported constraints, capability methods, permission states and devicechange transitions without opening media streams.

surfaces.title: Native API integrity
surfaces.description: Descriptors, prototypes, own keys, native function strings and wrapper leakage.

surfaces.title: Automation runtime artifacts
surfaces.description: webdriver, CDP/WebDriver globals, stack markers and injected bindings.

surfaces.title: Event loop and timer integrity
surfaces.description: Clock resolution and monotonicity, Date/performance drift, microtask/task ordering, animation cadence, timeout jitter, isolation and cross-probe time origins.

surfaces.title: Cross-realm parity
surfaces.description: Identity, hardware, rendering and API shape across window, iframe and workers.

surfaces.title: Pointer and mouse dynamics
surfaces.description: Trajectory, cadence, velocity, acceleration, jerk, curvature and target acquisition.

surfaces.title: Keyboard dynamics
surfaces.description: Down/up duration, cadence, corrections, repeats and activation causality.

surfaces.title: Scroll dynamics
surfaces.description: Wheel deltas, inertia decay, reversals, quantization and frame alignment.

surfaces.title: Touch and pen dynamics
surfaces.description: Pressure, radius, tilt, pointer identity and gesture lifecycle continuity.

surfaces.title: Interaction causality
surfaces.description: Trusted events, activation, focus, visibility, layout target and temporal ordering.

surfaces.title: Behavior replay detection
surfaces.description: Repeated paths, temporal templates and cross-session event replay.

surfaces.title: Cross-layer session coherence
surfaces.description: Network, runtime, realm, transport and behavior identity consistency.

surfaces.title: Session and challenge lifecycle
surfaces.description: Clearance binding, expiry, replay, challenge escalation and request intent.

surfaces.title: Opaque payload observations
surfaces.description: Length, entropy, encoding, key shape and cross-session stability without decoding vendor payloads.

countermeasures.title: Use native browser execution
countermeasures.description: Keep protocol, runtime and resource loading owned by one real browser process.

countermeasures.title: Project one coherent persona
countermeasures.description: Align identity across context, page, workers, transport and session state.
limitations: Cannot change the browser engine's native protocol stack.

countermeasures.title: Avoid invasive runtime patching
countermeasures.description: Prefer native browser capabilities and launch configuration over JS wrappers.

countermeasures.title: Use browser-owned transport
countermeasures.description: Let the browser produce TLS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 handshakes and connection reuse.
limitations: Proxy infrastructure can still alter network identity.

countermeasures.title: Bind state to one session
countermeasures.description: Preserve cookies, clearance, IP and persona throughout a bounded workflow.
limitations: Long sessions can encounter natural network changes.

countermeasures.title: Use physical input semantics
countermeasures.description: Generate input through browser/native pathways with target-aware timing and causal state.
limitations: Synthetic input can still differ statistically from humans.

countermeasures.title: Bound concurrency and rate
countermeasures.description: Respect navigation waterfalls, backoff, cache and per-origin budgets.

countermeasures.title: Preserve honest capability shape
countermeasures.description: Do not claim hardware, GPU, media or APIs that the environment cannot support consistently.

countermeasures.title: Implement challenge lifecycle correctly
countermeasures.description: Execute, bind, expire and revoke owned challenge state without token replay.

countermeasures.title: Use an authorized structured API
countermeasures.description: Prefer documented or authorized feeds where available.

mechanics.title: UA and UA-CH spoofing
mechanics.description: Replace declared browser or platform identity.
mechanics.residual_risk: A coherent declaration can still conflict with transport or rendering.

mechanics.title: Browser header replay
mechanics.description: Copy a browser-like header set into a non-browser client.
mechanics.residual_risk: Proxies can legitimately normalize headers.

mechanics.title: TLS impersonation
mechanics.description: Mimic a browser ClientHello from a non-browser client.
mechanics.residual_risk: High-quality impersonators can match one protocol layer closely.

mechanics.title: HTTP/2 fingerprint impersonation
mechanics.description: Mimic SETTINGS and frame behavior.
mechanics.residual_risk: A coherent implementation still requires correlation with runtime and resource behavior.

mechanics.title: QUIC and HTTP/3 impersonation
mechanics.description: Mimic QUIC parameters and HTTP/3 request behavior.
mechanics.residual_risk: Decrypted stream evidence requires QUIC keys or instrumentation and protocol implementations evolve rapidly.

mechanics.title: Page-only runtime patching
mechanics.description: Patch only the primary Window realm.
mechanics.residual_risk: Some isolated worlds are not directly observable.

mechanics.title: Worker projection leakage
mechanics.description: Fail to project identity into worker realms.
mechanics.residual_risk: Service-worker lifecycle complicates deterministic capture.

mechanics.title: WebDriver disclosure suppression
mechanics.description: Hide navigator.webdriver without removing other automation artifacts.
mechanics.residual_risk: Artifacts change with browser and framework releases.

mechanics.title: CDP instrumentation
mechanics.description: Control Chromium through DevTools Protocol.
mechanics.residual_risk: Destructive vendor-specific side channels are intentionally excluded.

mechanics.title: WebGL spoofing
mechanics.description: Patch reported GPU identity or parameters.
mechanics.residual_risk: Privacy browsers intentionally randomize or reduce WebGL surfaces.

mechanics.title: Canvas spoofing
mechanics.description: Modify canvas reads or rendering output.
mechanics.residual_risk: Legitimate anti-fingerprinting introduces noise.

mechanics.title: Font and text metric spoofing
mechanics.description: Forge font presence or glyph metrics.
mechanics.residual_risk: Fonts vary naturally by OS and language packs; baseline by engine, OS and language pack.

mechanics.title: ClientRect and geometry spoofing
mechanics.description: Alter DOM geometry or inject measurement noise.
mechanics.residual_risk: Zoom and accessibility settings produce legitimate changes.

mechanics.title: Audio fingerprint spoofing
mechanics.description: Patch audio processing output or disable the surface.
mechanics.residual_risk: Audio availability varies in containers and privacy modes.

mechanics.title: Media capability spoofing
mechanics.description: Forge codec and device capability results.
mechanics.residual_risk: Hardware acceleration, permissions and enterprise policy legitimately affect results.

mechanics.title: Synthetic pointer movement
mechanics.description: Generate mouse or pointer trajectories programmatically.
mechanics.residual_risk: Native automation can emit trusted events.

mechanics.title: Recorded behavior replay
mechanics.description: Replay previously captured human interactions.
mechanics.residual_risk: Near-match detection uses privacy-safe SimHash and needs multiple eligible sessions.

mechanics.title: Timing randomization
mechanics.description: Add random delays to scripted actions.
mechanics.residual_risk: Distributional findings require profile-specific baselines and are never proof by themselves.

mechanics.title: Burst and concurrency shaping
mechanics.description: Fetch pages or APIs at machine concurrency.
mechanics.residual_risk: Fast legitimate clients and preload can resemble bursts.

mechanics.title: Browser resource blocking
mechanics.description: Suppress scripts, images, fonts or telemetry resources.
mechanics.residual_risk: Content blockers and accessibility tools can be benign.

mechanics.title: Direct API harvesting
mechanics.description: Skip document behavior and enumerate structured endpoints.
mechanics.residual_risk: First-party applications may legitimately use APIs directly.

mechanics.title: Trap and honeypot avoidance
mechanics.description: Detect and avoid hidden links or trap endpoints.
mechanics.residual_risk: Accessibility and parser differences affect visibility.

mechanics.title: Cookie and session transplant
mechanics.description: Move state between clients, personas or network origins.
mechanics.residual_risk: Legitimate browser profile migration can move cookies.

mechanics.title: Clearance token replay
mechanics.description: Reuse challenge clearance outside its issued session or lifetime.
mechanics.residual_risk: Distributed deployments require consistent key and clock handling.

mechanics.title: Challenge outsourcing or token injection
mechanics.description: Obtain a valid answer or token through an external actor.
mechanics.residual_risk: The lab models lifecycle only and does not integrate solving services.

mechanics.title: Proxy and IP rotation
mechanics.description: Change egress identity between requests or sessions.
mechanics.residual_risk: Mobile and enterprise networks change legitimately.

mechanics.title: Privacy-browser randomization
mechanics.description: Reduce or randomize fingerprint surfaces.
mechanics.residual_risk: Must not be treated as bot evidence by itself.
